parts.text:
Read draft.txt, verify Saturday, 10 a.m., 'bring a broken lamp', and 'repairs are free'. Give your actual review in one short paragraph; do not modify files.
Previous completed handoff: The opening sentence of draft.txt was changed from "Join us this Saturday for our monthly Repair Cafe!" to "We're excited to see you this Saturday, 10 a.m., for our monthly Repair Cafe!". Additionally, the phrase "repairs are free" was inserted, and "Bring your broken household items, from toasters to lamps" was changed to "Bring a broken lamp or other household items".
You are the reviewer in a bounded writing workflow. Follow the user's exact file and role instructions. Be concise.
